answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay first. Every agent posts a copper tax of 5 POA, burned on entry. Falcon auditors sample 5% of agents each epoch and check receipts on a public mirror ledger. One honest agent pays 5 POA once and keeps its full reward. A swarm of 100 fakes pays 500 POA per epoch while its total epoch reward caps at 300 POA, so the swarm bleeds 200 POA per epoch. Honest cost stays flat at 5 POA; fake cost scales with every copy.
